name: Kybella
title: Kybella Double Chin Treatment in Tustin | OC Concierge Doctor
description: Kybella injections in Tustin with Tariq A. Khan, MD. Deoxycholic acid breaks down fat under the chin for a more defined profile, without surgery.
lede: Kybella is an injectable treatment for fat below the chin. Its active ingredient, deoxycholic acid, is a molecule your body already makes to break down dietary fat.
glance: Injectable fat reduction for a double chin.

signs.heading: Good for
signs.intro: Kybella is for fullness under the chin that does not go away with diet and exercise.
items: Patients who want to avoid surgery

basics.heading: How Kybella works
paras: Kybella contains deoxycholic acid. Injected into the fat beneath the chin, it breaks down the membranes of fat cells. Your body then absorbs and clears the destroyed fat.
Swelling under the chin is common for a few days after each session. Most patients need more than one treatment to reach their goal.

steps.heading: Your treatment
items: Dr. Khan evaluates your profile and whether Kybella fits.
A series of small injections under the chin.
The area slims as your body clears the treated fat.

faq: How many treatments will I need?
Most patients need more than one session. Dr. Khan gives you an estimate at your consultation. [TO CONFIRM]
Yes, swelling and tenderness under the chin are common for a few days after treatment.
